name: EveryO
description: Build neural networks from scratch in NumPy, then accelerate with CUDA and validate against TensorFlow—readable, correct, and trustable.

paragraphs: Your all-in-one toolkit for exploring artificial intelligence on your own computer — no internet, no API keys, no coding required.

EveryO is a free, open-source program that lets you create, train, and test artificial intelligence models right on your personal computer. Think of it as a workshop for AI — you provide the ideas, and EveryO provides the tools to bring them to life.

Whether you're curious about how machines learn, want to experiment with computer vision (teaching computers to "see"), or need to run complex calculations using your graphics card (GPU), EveryO handles all the heavy lifting behind the scenes.
features: No complex installation process. Download, open, and you are ready to explore.
EveryO uses your computer's powerful components — CPU and GPU — to run calculations up to 10x faster than standard software.
All interactions are handled through a clean, visual interface. You click, drag, and configure. Everything else is automatic.
This advanced feature handles mathematical calculations automatically, so you never need to figure out gradients or derivatives manually.
Watch your neural network learn and improve in real time. See graphs, charts, and error rates update as your model trains.
